evidence.note: diffs compare structure+value fingerprints locally; no values are stored here. A fully unpinned run (real Date) is not replayable offline: the captured token is expired -> watchdog reload, n=0. Date stays on the DET step clock in every unpinned group; Date-driven fields are D by code-read (STUBS registry).
